line_rate_waveform.encoding: 8b/10b — 8 source bits become 10 wire bits; embedded clock + DC balance.

packet_framing_waveform.tlp_framing: STP (K27.7) → 12-bit Sequence Number → TLP header (3 or 4 DW) → optional data payload → 16-bit LCRC → END (K29.7), or EDB (K30.7) for nullified TLP.
packet_framing_waveform.dllp_framing: SDP (K28.2) → DLLP type byte + DLLP-specific fields → 16-bit CRC → END (K29.7).
packet_framing_waveform.lane_placement: STP / SDP MUST be placed on Lane 0 when the Link is wider than x1.
packet_framing_waveform.logical_idle: When no TLP / DLLP / ordered-set is being transmitted, IDL data character (00h) is sent on all Lanes, scrambled and 8b/10b-encoded.

TS1.purpose: Polling and Configuration training; carries Link Number, Lane Number, N_FTS count, Data Rate field, training control bits.

TS2.purpose: Final-handshake training set — confirms Lane / Link agreement before transitioning to L0.

SKP.purpose: Skip ordered set; receiver elastic buffer adds/removes one SKP symbol to absorb ±300 ppm clock-tolerance.

FTS.purpose: Fast Training Sequence — used to exit L0s to L0.

EIOS.purpose: Electrical Idle Ordered Set — transmitted just before TX enters Electrical Idle.

EIEOS.purpose: Electrical Idle Exit Ordered Set — used on exit from Electrical Idle to re-acquire symbol lock.

ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.Detect_to_Polling: Receiver-detect circuit senses far-end termination on the differential pair.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.Polling_to_Configuration: Both ends have observed sufficient consecutive TS1 / TS2 ordered sets with valid Lane/Link numbers.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.Configuration_to_L0: Lane width + Lane number agreement complete; both ends have sent N consecutive TS2 with no further training mods.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.L0_to_L0s: Either end transmits EIOS then enters Electrical Idle on its TX direction. Independent per direction.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.L0s_to_L0: Transmitter sends N_FTS Fast Training Sequences + SKP → both ends in symbol lock → return to L0.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.L0_to_L1: Both ends agree via PM_Enter_L1 DLLPs; LTSSM transitions through Recovery briefly.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.L1_to_L0: Upstream component initiates Recovery; Link re-trains then returns to L0.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.L0_to_L2: Software-driven via PM_Enter_L23 DLLPs; TX enters Electrical Idle; REFCLK may stop.
ltssm_transition_trigger_waveform.L2_to_Detect: Beacon (or WAKE# at system level) brings PERST# de-assertion or LTSSM reset; full re-train from Detect.

clock_tolerance_compensation.purpose: Allows the receive elastic buffer to absorb or generate one SKP symbol per interval, compensating for up to ±300 ppm clock-rate mismatch between TX and RX.

general_timing_rule: Underlying PCIe Transaction Layer enforces TLP ordering rules. Posted writes (MWr including CQE writes) cannot pass other posted writes. Read completion TLPs can be reordered relative to posted writes. CAP.TO bounds CC.EN ↔ CSTS.RDY transition in 500 ms units; typical CAP.TO ≤ 60 (30 s).
transmitter_eye_diagram_reference: Figure 4-32 — Minimum Transmitter Timing and Voltage Output Compliance Specification.
receiver_eye_diagram_reference: Figure 4-34 — Minimum Receiver Eye Timing and Voltage Compliance Specification.

voltage_levels.ac_coupling: Required at both ends; common-mode at TX and RX can differ.

clock_waveform.host_clock_source: PCI Express reference clock (100 MHz nominal); SerDes recovered clock internal to PCIe PHY.
clock_waveform.controller_clock_source: PCIe REFCLK on the connector; controller derives internal clocks via PLLs.
clock_waveform.protocol_layer_timing: NVMe protocol layer is event-driven and asynchronous from the host's CPU clock domain.

doorbell_write_waveform.host_action: Host CPU performs an MMIO 32-bit write to SQyTDBL register.
doorbell_write_waveform.transport: Translated by host root complex into a PCIe Memory Write TLP targeting controller's BAR0/BAR1.
doorbell_write_waveform.controller_action: Controller latches the new SQ Tail Pointer and schedules a fetch of pending SQ entries.

sq_fetch_waveform.controller_action: Controller issues PCIe Memory Read TLPs to the SQ ring.
sq_fetch_waveform.transport: Root complex returns Memory Read Completion TLPs with the 64-byte SQE payload.
sq_fetch_waveform.controller_processes: Controller decodes CDW0.OPC + NSID; follows PRP/SGL pointers.

data_transfer_waveform_read.controller_action: For Read (OPC=02h): controller issues PCIe Memory Write TLPs targeting host PRP/SGL data buffers.
data_transfer_waveform_read.metadata: If metadata present, written to MPTR or interleaved per FLBAS.MS.
data_transfer_waveform_read.ordering: All data writes posted before the CQE write.

data_transfer_waveform_write.controller_action: For Write (OPC=01h): controller issues PCIe Memory Read TLPs against host data buffers.
data_transfer_waveform_write.metadata: If metadata present, read from MPTR or per FLBAS.MS.

cqe_post_waveform.controller_action: Controller issues one PCIe Memory Write TLP targeting the CQ ring.
cqe_post_waveform.phase_tag: Phase Tag bit inverted on each ring wrap.
cqe_post_waveform.ordering: CQE write is the producer barrier — preceding data writes globally observable first.

interrupt_waveform.msi_x_action: Controller issues an MSI-X Message TLP; vector index per Create I/O CQ.IV.
interrupt_waveform.host_action: Host CPU's interrupt controller delivers the IRQ; driver reads CQEs and rings CQyHDBL.

controller_initialization_waveform.step_1: Host BIOS/OS enumerates the PCI Function; assigns BAR0/BAR1.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_2: Host driver reads CAP and VS.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_4: Host writes CC with CC.MPS, CC.AMS, CC.CSS, CC.IOSQES=6, CC.IOCQES=4, CC.EN=1.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_5: Host polls CSTS.RDY until 1 (CAP.TO × 500 ms timeout).
controller_initialization_waveform.step_6: Host issues Identify Controller via Admin SQ.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_7: Host creates I/O queues via Create I/O CQ then Create I/O SQ.
controller_initialization_waveform.step_8: Controller is in RUNNING state servicing I/O commands.

nssr_waveform.step_1: If CAP.NSSRS=1, host writes 0x4E564D65 ('NVMe') to NSSR.NSSRC.
nssr_waveform.step_2: Subsystem performs NVM Subsystem Reset; all controllers reset.
nssr_waveform.step_3: CSTS.NSSRO=1 indicates last reset was NSSR.
nssr_waveform.step_4: Host follows the same controller bring-up flow as power-on.
